description: This file defines generic vector data structures and associated inline functions for managing dynamic arrays of a specific type, including initialization, allocation, freeing, resizing, pushing, and popping elements.

methods.name: vector_resize
methods.description: Resizes the given vector data array, adjusting its size to accommodate additional elements.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_init
methods.description: Initializes the vector structure by setting data pointer to NULL and size counters to zero.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new vector structure.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_clear
methods.description: Clears the vector's contents, freeing associated memory and resetting the vector.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_free
methods.description: Frees the vector structure and its contents.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the vector to accommodate additional elements.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_push
methods.description: Appends an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: vector_\<name\>_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element from the vector.
